title: Actual finite-quotient constant model predicates
statement: For a scheme X, an adic coefficient datum (A,I), comparison maps phi from the constant finite coefficient sheaves to the actual finite coefficient sheaves, and a derived completed-coefficient object M, FinitePerfectModelsOn at n,V,a,b means that an etale covering sieve of V provides algebraic finite-projective complexes over A/I^(n+1) supported in [a,b], whose termwise constant realization, changed by phi, is isomorphic on the concrete localized pro-etale site to the actual quotient reduction of M. Its auxiliary definitions give the termwise universe lift and constant realization, a cover with one interval working at every finite level, constant-section normalization of phi, and the two quotient/scalar compatibility equations. All are the already published definitions, relocated unchanged. The standard derived-category and slice sheafification instances remain unchanged.

source.place: Tag 09C2, lemma-describe-constructible-complexes; sites-cohomology.tex Tag 094I, perfect-residue ideal-filtration argument; connected etale perfect constancy.

proof.text: Use the standard derived localization and essentially-small-site sheafification instances. Realize each algebraic complex termwise by the existing universe-lift, scalar-restriction, and constant-module functors. The local-model, uniform-cover, normalization and compatibility predicates are exactly the displayed existential and equality formulas; no data or proof is postulated.

proof_origin.place: Unchanged interface extracted from the existing finite-perfect quotient-model module

lean.statement:
def FinitePerfectModelsOn (X : Scheme.{t}) {A : Type t} [CommRing A]
    (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    [∀ n : ℕ, (koszulConstantFunctor X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    (φ : ∀ n : ℕ, adicConstantRing X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)) ⟶
      completedAdicFiniteCommRing X d n)
    (M : DerivedCategory (CompletedAdicModules X d)) (n : ℕ) (V : X.Etale)
    (a b : ℤ) : Prop
